description: Three-seed benchmark aggregation for final-candidate SC-INR. Seed1 uses historical raw key SC-INR+PhiZ; seed2/3 use cleaned raw key SC-INR.

1.command: existing seed1 final-candidate benchmark; raw key SC-INR+PhiZ

2.command: CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python entrypoints/eval_full.py --device 0 --save_root artifacts/checkpoints/seed2 --models SC-INR --output artifacts/raw_results/seed2/benchmark_sc_inr.json

3.command: CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 python entrypoints/eval_full.py --device 0 --save_root artifacts/checkpoints/seed3 --models SC-INR --output artifacts/raw_results/seed3/benchmark_sc_inr.json

notes: Do not mix legacy raw key SC-INR in old seed2/seed3 benchmark.json with final-candidate SC-INR.
Delta table uses paired seed deltas against the 2026-05-09 core per-seed summary.
Standard deviations are sample standard deviations over three seeds or three paired deltas.
